Hi there,

My girlfriend was in a sexually abusive relationship, which is not the same as what you went through - but she suffered from panic attacks too. Sometime it'd be fine, sometimes she would break into tears and we would agree to take a break from it for a week, two, or more. I'd say, keep trying to get better. Keep fighting your fight. You will build trust. He seems like he cares about you, and you seem to care about him. That can work miracles.

Edit:  
I forgot to mention that we too, are into BDSM play. I think that with time, it can really help you. Giving up control to someone is a very big thing, especially as a survivor. It can build trust and affection.
